features.name: Purchase Journal for Payables
features.description: Feature that allows registration of expenses for items not tracked in inventory, with ability to select GL accounts and preview GL posting before posting the transaction.

features.name: Purchase Invoice for Multi-type Transactions
features.description: Feature enabling creation of purchase invoices that can accommodate multiple line types including inventory items, non-inventoried items, fixed assets, and freight expenses with GL account selection.

features.name: GL Posting Preview
features.description: Ability to see a preview of GL accounts the transaction will be posted to before posting, similar to the distributions button in Dynamics GP.

features.name: Vendor Information Auto-population
features.description: When selecting a vendor on a purchase invoice, vendor information defaults in automatically from the vendor record.
